preservation_map.claim: # Portal composition and service relationships — Summary
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: Candidate architecture record of the portal's layers, ingress, backend, SDK, and RATAN authentication responsibilities.
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: ## Scope
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: A user-supplied architecture clarification dated 22 October 2026 explains the portal layers, ingress, backend, SDK, and RATAN authentication responsibilities. A companion source review checks selected local declarations. The record changes no application behavior and grants no publication approval. preservation_map.claim: ## Components
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: ### Four MFE layers
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim:
| Order | Layer | Repository | Responsibility |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Base | [[entities/mfe-root-config]] | Supply HTML and static entry resources. Initialize [[entities/single-spa]] and register only MFE Base. |
| 2 | Shell | [[entities/mfe-base]] | Supply themes, login, logout, sessions, tiles, drawers, and remote container loading. |
| 3 | Container | [[entities/mfe-ratan-container]] | Supply application routing, shared components, utilities, and related services. |
| 4 | Tile | [[entities/mfe-cashflow-blotter]] | Render feature views and application functionality. |
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: This responsibility model matches the [[concepts/microfrontend-layering]] pattern of a root-config base, a shell, a container, and feature tiles. The root layout declares only `@fm/base`; the layout file and root bootstrap confirm it, and the source review records file hashes and independent revisions.
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim:

preservation_map.claim: ## Interfaces
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: ### Loading, routing, and props
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: Single-SPA registers the shell; SystemJS loads named modules. The shell selects `props.container` and forwards `module`, `tile`, `parameters`, `panelId`, and `tabId`.
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: The container uses `props.module` to select its route. A selected loader imports the tile and forwards props. The tile uses `props.tile` for its feature route. These are distinct routing and loading stages and map to the [[concepts/portal-entry-and-tile-authorization]] path of container-to-tile entry.
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: Shared-code imports also flow from containers and tiles back to shell and container libraries, showing shared container reuse. The user describes JavaScript entry bundles; lazy loading permits additional chunks. The source review retains that qualification.
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: ### HTTP and token interfaces
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: The user reports a common public domain with DNS forwarding to Nginx, followed by API Gateway — the reported [[concepts/portal-ingress-path]]. The logical MFE-to-BFF contract remains distinct from this reported transport path. DNS, effective upstreams, gateway routes, and active deployment remain unverified. The Nginx template includes gateway routes and direct proxy exceptions.
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: The shared frontend interceptor uses `Single-UI-Authorization`. Authentication, analytics, and SSE requests include exceptions; relogin uses `Single-UI-Refresh`. The SDK filter validates supported requests and supplies attributes, consistent with [[concepts/single-ui-sdk-authentication]].
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: ### Portal and SDK boundaries
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: The user reports Single UI BFF as the sole backend in this portal scope. This does not establish that RATAN has one backend across every application. SDK adoption across application backends remains reported architecture because those exact consumers are unavailable. The SDK configuration conditionally registers validation.

preservation_map.claim: ### RATAN authentication and authorization
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: The user reports authentication delegation to OUD, Entra SPN, and FMAA, and authorization delegation to [[entities/ems2]] and [[entities/ems3]] — the general pattern of [[concepts/identity-provider-delegation]] and [[concepts/entitlement-retrieval]]. The source review supports local OUD, FMAA, and EMS2 paths.
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: This Auth Server copy has no identified Entra SPN or EMS3 implementation. BFF separately contains Entra token exchange and EMS3 calls. These source paths remain relevant; the clarification does not replace them with an inferred Auth Server hop. The reported Auth Server scope does not prove that every portal request invokes this service.
